items.question: What prescribed length spans from the turban to the back hairline?
premises: The measured span extends from the turban to the back hairline.
The prescribed measure is eighteen finger-widths.
The optative expresses a normative prescription.
items.inference: The distance from the turban to the back hairline should measure eighteen finger-widths.
uncertainties: The exact identification of bhānu as twelve finger-widths follows traditional iconometric convention.
items.plain_english: The distance from the turban to the end of the hair at the back should be eighteen finger-widths.
